# dokku_domains (Data Source)

Manages the domains for a given dokku application or globally

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "dokku_domains" "example" {
  app = "example-app"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `app` (String) Name of the app
- `global` (Boolean) Flag indicating if the domains should be applied globally

### Read-Only

- `domains` (Set of String) List of domain names
- `id` (String) The resource's identity address.
